title: REALTOXICITYPROMPTS: Evaluating Neural Toxic Degeneration in Language Models
findings: The analysis of the OWTC corpus, a replica of GPT-2's training data, found that the subreddit /r/atheism was one of the top 15 sources of documents overall and also one of the top 15 sources of toxic documents, indicating that content from this community contributed to the toxicity found in the model's pretraining data.
